summary: FS Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $5.0 million of its common stock. The program runs for 12 months until August 24, 2027, commencing no sooner than the second trading day after the announcement. Repurchases may occur in open market or private transactions, or via a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, at management's discretion, subject to market conditions and other factors. The company may suspend or terminate the program at any time. No specific price per share or premium was stated. What to watch: pace of repurchases and impact on EPS and capital ratios.
